question: Can a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified arithmetically BEFORE freeze (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one task family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms) with real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction, honest per-condition counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), contamination/dynamic-range certificate, and exclusion of mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class?
hypothesis: A credential-free asymmetric-discovery multi-task substrate (session/resource/schema discovery amortized or cached across tasks) can satisfy: dynamic range present (both baselines < 0.95 at novelty>=0.5), matched correctness>=0.80 for all arms, treatment/comparator behaviorally distinct, counters honest and complete, contamination bounds satisfied; otherwise certificate is unsatisfiable (bounded substrate-class negative, freeze nothing).
falsifier: For all credential-free substrates tested that are materially different from mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class, the arithmetic certificate fails (baselines not below ceiling at high novelty, or matched correctness < 0.80, or treatment==comparator by behavior, or counters incomplete/tainted). In that case outcome is UNSATISFIABLE with bounded negative for B2 substrate; no execution of treatment effect beyond certification.

baselines.description: Cold re-derivation from minimal priors (no pre-cached solution path for the instance), matched task family and constraints.
baselines.constraint: success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on >= 1 task family; matched correctness >= 0.80

baselines.description: Retrieval-shaped comparator (shaped recall/usage of prior artifacts) distinct from cold and from treatment; must not be pinned at 1.0.
baselines.constraint: success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.5 on >= 1 task family; matched correctness >= 0.80

positive_control: synthetic_non_degenerate_family: constructed family with novelty>=0.5 exhibits baselines < 0.95 and all arms >=0.80 correctness (sensitivity control).
null_control: degenerate_ceiling_family: constructed family where dynamic range should be zero or baselines approach ceiling -> certificate rejects (control sensitivity).
measurement_validity: honest_counters: http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts reported per arm per condition; no double-counting
contamination: no leakage of solution artifacts between train/test instances; discovery amortization explicitly modeled; credential-free
exclusion: mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class explicitly excluded (no fourth re-run)
behavioral_distinct: treatment/comparator differ on >=1 observable behavior (not identity)
matched_tasks: same task families/constraints across arms; correctness matched >=0.80
stable_ids: metric/control identities fixed before any satisfiability probe
decision_rule: CERTIFIED if (exists task family with novelty>=0.5 and B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.success_rate < 0.95 and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.success_rate < 0.95) AND (all arms matched_correctness>=0.80) AND (treatment!=comparator behaviorally) AND (counters complete and contamination bounds satisfied). Else UNSATISFIABLE -> bounded substrate-class negative; freeze nothing.
product_consequence_positive: Reusable asymmetric-discovery task bank substrate certified (non-degenerate dynamic range) -> unblocks B2 inheritance benchmarks (C-PARAM-INHERIT/C-LLM-INHERIT) with honest cost accounting.
product_consequence_negative: Certificate unsatisfiable on every tested credential-free substrate (different from mandatory-discovery deterministic REST) -> bounded negative for B2 substrate; do not proceed to full flagship benchmark; repair substrate or PARK thread; freeze nothing.
estimated_cost: low (arithmetic certification + small satisfiability probes; no large-scale outcome measurement)
expected_information_gain: high (removes B2 ceiling-blocker; prevents misreading replay-speed as economics).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Arithmetic constraints are decidable from measured/constructed families; UNSATISFIABLE branch exists and is reachable.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Counters, novelty metric, correctness, behavioral distinction observable from existing harness instrumentation (no new unverified substrate required).

baseline_identifiability.reason: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED defined with explicit success_rate constraints and novelty threshold; distinct from treatment.

control_sensitivity.reason: Positive control (non-degenerate family) should satisfy certificate; null control (degenerate ceiling family) should reject certificate.

treatment_liveness.reason: This is a substrate certification experiment (arithmetic gate) to qualify substrates for treatment arms in downstream B2; no SPIDER treatment arm is executed in this experiment. Liveness not required for certification.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No mutable local code/data/task-bank/fixture dependencies identified that could change interpretation of the arithmetic certificate beyond existing read-only harness definitions. Substrate families may be constructed on-the-fly from read-only primitives; no new mutable artifacts introduced.
